interpretation_boundaries: 见吉 modifies the preceding annual fire-risk structure; it is not a multi-year persistence phrase
火灾后 describes a downstream consequence path, not a measured prior event fact
the antecedent TP03-247 is CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY / EVENT_CANDIDATE and cannot become an executable required antecedent
吉 remains an open evaluative shorthand; no member set or activation cardinality is inferred

human_gate_applicability.reason: no multi-year persistence condition is present

gap006.reason: The phrase evaluates annual periods as 良好 without an independent criterion, matching the accepted Career-scoped PERIOD_VALENCE_OR_SUPPORT class. This does not define a GOOD_YEAR predicate.
